Units range from 4 to 16 kW (1-phase) and 8 to 16 kW (3-phase), and up to eight can run in parallel for up to 128 kW. That suits hotels, hostels and other buildings with high hot-water demand. Multiple noise-reduction measures keep it as quiet as 35 dB at 3 m.

features.title: Multiple Noise Reduction
features.text: Sound-absorbing compressor wrap, damping material, a folded-edge fan, a low-resistance mesh cover and insulation cotton bring noise as low as 35 dB at 3 m (AUX lab data).

features.title: Explosion-Proof Design
features.text: An airtight electric control box separated from any leaked refrigerant, with explosion-proof joints and parts.

features.title: Parallel Connection
features.text: Up to 8 units in parallel for up to 128 kW, with a free choice of how many units serve domestic hot water.

features.title: Module Rotation & Remote Monitoring
features.text: Rotates modules and lets staff monitor status and change settings remotely from the office.

name: R32 Monoblock Heat Pump
subtitle: Air-to-Water Monoblock Heat Pump – Heating, Cooling & Hot Water
bullets: Hot water at ambient temperatures from -25 °C to 43 °C
overview: The AUX R32 Monoblock is an all-DC inverter air-to-water heat pump for space heating, cooling and domestic hot water. It heats from -25 °C to 35 °C ambient, makes hot water from -25 °C to 43 °C and cools from -5 °C to 52 °C, with outlet water up to 65 °C using the compressor alone. Four control methods, dual-temperature control for radiators and underfloor heating, and ECO mode make it flexible for homes and small buildings.

features.title: Wide Operating Range
features.text: All-DC components with an electronic expansion valve: heating -25 to 35 °C, hot water -25 to 43 °C, cooling -5 to 52 °C. Outlet water up to 65 °C and tank water up to 57 °C (AUX lab data).

features.title: Flexible Control
features.text: Four control methods: outlet temperature, indoor temperature sensor, room thermostat or buffer tank.

features.title: Dual-Temperature Control
features.text: Mixing pumps and three-way valves supply high-temperature water for radiators and medium/low-temperature water for underfloor heating at the same time.

features.title: ECO Mode
features.text: The two temperature zones can each control inlet water temperature automatically.
